name: Tandem Stance

instructions.description: Stand near a stable support and place one foot directly in front of the other as if on a line.
Distribute your weight evenly and keep your torso upright.
Focus on a stable point and breathe steadily while holding the position.
Step out carefully and repeat with the opposite foot in front.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Turn the static tandem position into a slow walking drill.

commentsNotes: Widen the stance slightly if needed for safety.
Keep the knees soft rather than rigid.
